card.name: Lists of roles and professional groups
card.fires_on: Commas, 'and' and other connectors inside lists of professions, instruments, institutions or expert-group names, such as 'composer, conductor, teacher, and violinist'. It also fires inside names of specialist groups and teams.

modes.label: Profession lists
modes.description: The comma or 'and' within a series of occupations or music-related roles.
modes.example: Leopold Mozart (November 14, 1719 – May 28, 1787) was a composer<<,>> conductor, teacher, and violinist.

modes.label: Group and institution names
modes.description: Partway through names of expert groups, teams or colleges followed by a place or title.
modes.example: Dr Claude Gascon, co-chair of the IUCN Amphib<<ian>> Specialist Group and Executive Vice President of Conservation

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mostly unrelated foreign fragments, and 'voice' words are suppressed, so it may steer the next word away from 'voice' in music-role lists.
card.plain: It lights up in lists of jobs, such as composer, conductor and violinist, and in names of expert groups.
